_comment: Cluster tag catalogue and routing policy. The LLM only proposes a tag; this file decides the action.

ASN_VOID.description: A request to void or cancel an advance shipping notice (ASN) that was never received.

ITEM_FILE_MISSING.description: A newly set up item is missing at the store, or its price is missing because the item file did not arrive.

BATCH_JOB_HUNG.description: A monitoring alert that a store batch process (for example BATCH01) is hung.

ACCESS_REQUEST.description: A password reset, account lockout or access request for a store or corporate system.

NETWORK_OUTAGE.description: The store network, WAN or internet connection is down or unreachable.

STORE_HARDWARE.description: Physical store hardware is broken: receipt printers, scanners, label printers, cash drawers.

PRICING_MISMATCH.description: The shelf label or register shows a wrong price, or prices disagree between systems.

POS_DOWN.description: Registers or the point-of-sale service cannot scan, sell or start.
